visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Two men are in a brightly lit indoor room. One man sits on a wooden chair, holding and playing an acoustic guitar; he wears a white long-sleeved shirt under a black knitted vest and black trousers. The other man stands behind him to the right, wearing a light blue and white checkered shirt over a white t-shirt and khaki pants, looking on with an emotional expression. (2) The camera zooms in to a medium close-up of the standing man who looks puzzled and places his hands over his chest while a question mark graphic appears. The guitarist continues to look down at his instrument, his fingers moving across the strings. (3) The shot widens back to a medium shot as the guitarist sings passionately. The standing man covers his mouth and then holds the sides of his head as if overwhelmed by the music. (4) The scene shifts to a slightly closer angle. The standing man starts gesturing with his hands and singing along, his face showing high intensity and emotion. The guitarist is seen singing with his eyes closed, fully immersed in the performance. (5) A series of quick cuts and dissolves show both men singing together with great fervor. The standing man has his eyes closed and hands clasped. (6) The music ends, and the camera captures a close-up of the two men. Both have red, watery eyes and begin to cry openly, wiping away tears with their hands and sleeves. (7) The standing man turns away from the camera, sobbing into his hands, while the guitarist looks towards the camera with a tear-streaked face and a sad smile.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A solo male voice begins singing with a gentle, melodic tone accompanied by a warm acoustic guitar strumming pattern. The pitch is moderate and the delivery is clean with a reflective mood. (2) The acoustic guitar continues with steady, rhythmic strumming. The vocals transition to a higher pitch and greater intensity, showing signs of emotional strain and breathiness as the melody ascends. (3) A second male voice enters in harmony. The two voices blend with high emotional arousal, singing loudly and with significant vibrato. The guitar playing becomes more vigorous to match the vocal energy. (4) The song reaches a peak where the vocals are belted out, exhibiting high tension and spectral brightness. The acoustic space feels intimate but resonant. (5) The guitar strumming abruptly slows down and eventually stops. There is a moment of near silence before a shaky male voice asks a question in a low, conversational tone. (6) Sounds of sobbing and heavy breathing are clearly audible. The two men speak short, broken phrases through tears, their voices cracking with high emotional valence and sadness. (7) The recording ends with the sound of sniffing and a faint, muffled vocal sign of comfort.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video presents a heartfelt musical cover of a sentimental song, using a shared performance between two men to build an atmosphere of deep empathy and vulnerability, which ends in an exaggerated emotional release (crying) to connect with the audience's feelings of loneliness or struggle.
